plugin.note: Skeletal Wyvern strategy: draconic dragonbane target with a 25% Fire elemental weakness. Carry an anti-icy-breath shield at all times; safespot methods depend on the 10-minute aggression timer before swapping to offensive shields.

requirements: 70 combat and Elemental Workshop I before assignment
Elemental shield, mind shield, dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield for icy-breath protection
Dragon Slayer I started if using dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield
Asgarnian Ice Dungeon access south of Port Sarim; fairy ring AIQ and Agility shortcuts can speed travel
mechanics: Skeletal Wyverns attack with melee, ranged, and a unique ice-breath attack.
Melee is only used in melee distance and can hit up to 13.
The ranged attack reaches 6 tiles and can hit up to 13.
Icy breath reaches 5 tiles and can hit 50+ without an appropriate shield.
Elemental, mind, dragonfire, ancient wyvern, and dragonfire ward shields reduce icy breath to a maximum hit of 10.
There is still a 1/7 freeze chance while using a protective shield; the ancient wyvern shield grants immunity to that freeze.
Without a protective shield, freeze chance is affected by Magic defensive bonuses.
Skeletal Wyverns are draconic and are vulnerable to dragonbane weapons and enchanted dragonstone bolt Dragon's breath effects.
The current monster page lists a 25% Fire elemental weakness.
They are not undead, so Salve amulet bonuses do not apply.
The lower Asgarnian Ice Dungeon allows dwarf multicannon use, while the upper Slayer-only area does not.

methods.label: Requirements and transportation
methods.summary: Reach the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon wyvern area with the required Slayer level and shield protection.
recommendedFor: Players banking between short Slayer-task trips
Konar tasks locked to the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon
steps: Enter the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon south of Port Sarim and north of Mudskipper Point.
Run north, then east to the ice warrior and ice giant room, then use the southern entrance to the wyvern lair.
Use fairy ring AIQ or the Port Sarim route for travel; level 72 or 82 Agility shortcuts shorten the dungeon path.
Use the icy steps near the exit when killing in the task-only upper area.
Equip or carry an anti-icy-breath shield before entering combat.
risks: Assignment requires Elemental Workshop I because the task expects access to at least the elemental shield.
Starting Dragon Slayer I is required before using dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield.

methods.label: Attacks and protection
methods.summary: Plan around ranged hits, melee distance, and high-damage icy breath.
requiredOrKeyItems: Ancient wyvern shield for freeze immunity
steps: Always account for the 50+ icy breath max hit if the player is not protected by an appropriate shield.
Use an elemental, mind, dragonfire, ancient wyvern, or dragonfire ward shield to reduce icy breath to a max hit of 10.
Use an ancient wyvern shield when freeze immunity matters more than offensive shield bonuses.
Use Protect from Missiles when standing at distance and not fully safespotting because the ranged attack is frequent.
Use Protect from Melee when meleeing in direct contact.
Continue eating or drinking potions while frozen; the freeze prevents retaliating, not inventory actions.
risks: Armour does not affect icy-breath accuracy.
Protective shields reduce icy breath but do not fully remove freeze chance unless using the ancient wyvern shield.
A failed safespot lure can expose the player to icy breath again.

methods.label: Dragonbane melee
methods.summary: Use dragon hunter lance or high-accuracy melee while praying melee.
recommendedFor: Players with strong melee gear and enough supplies
requiredOrKeyItems: Voidwaker or other special attack weapon
steps: Use dragon hunter lance as the best melee weapon because Skeletal Wyverns are draconic.
Use the Swipe or Pound attack style with dragon hunter lance when paired with Oathplate or Inquisitor-style setups.
Use Inquisitor's mace, Blade of saeldor, Osmumten's fang, Abyssal whip, or Zombie axe when dragon hunter lance is unavailable.
Keep Protect from Melee active while standing in melee distance.
Carry food and prayer potions because melee does not avoid ranged or icy-breath pressure.
Use a special attack weapon only if the shield plan still keeps icy-breath protection available.
risks: Skeletal Wyverns have very high stab defence, so lower-tier stab weapons can underperform.
Direct melee consumes more food than safespotting.

methods.label: Ranged safespot
methods.summary: Use crossbow or Bow of faerdhinen range from a safespot after aggression expires.
recommendedFor: Players prioritising safety over direct melee speed
requiredOrKeyItems: Bow of faerdhinen with crystal armour
Mind shield or other protective shield
Offensive ranged shield for after aggression
prayers: Protect from Missiles while setting up
steps: Wait until the wyverns become tolerant after about 10 minutes in the same aggression area.
Trap a wyvern on the main cave entrance, the western or southern side of the ice structure, or the task-only-area safespot.
Attack from outside the wyvern's 6-tile ranged range when possible, or use Protect from Missiles while setting up.
Use Dragon hunter crossbow with diamond dragon bolts (e) as the strongest ranged dragonbane path.
Use Bow of faerdhinen with crystal armour, Hunters' sunlight crossbow, Zaryte crossbow, Armadyl crossbow, Dragon crossbow, or Rune crossbow as alternatives.
After the wyverns are tolerant and the safespot is stable, switch from the protective shield to a ranged-bonus shield such as a buckler or ward.
Keep the protective shield in the inventory because a bad lure can expose the player to icy breath again.
risks: Moving too far deeper into the cave can reset aggression and break the safespot.
Wyverns are not always lured correctly behind obstacles.
Offensive shields do not replace icy-breath protection when the safespot fails.

methods.label: Ranged Void safespot
methods.summary: Use the strategy page's Void ranged setup when high Ranged makes it stronger than ordinary dragonhide.
steps: Use the same safespot and aggression-loss process as the standard ranged method.
Use Void ranged when the account has at least 92 Ranged and lacks stronger Armadyl-or-better armour.
Start with a protective shield while wyverns are aggressive.
Switch to ranged offensive gear only after the safespot is stable and the wyverns are tolerant.
Keep the shield in the inventory to recover from bad lures.
risks: Void ranged is fragile if the safespot fails.
This method assumes a stable safespot rather than tanking.

methods.label: Magic Fire safespot
methods.summary: Use Dragon hunter wand or Fire spells from a safespot to exploit the Fire elemental weakness.
recommendedFor: Players using Fire spell damage bonuses
prayers: Protect from Missiles while setting up
steps: Use Dragon hunter wand with Fire spells where available because Skeletal Wyverns are draconic and have a Fire elemental weakness.
Use Harmonised nightmare staff, Toxic staff of the dead, Kodai wand, Staff of the dead, or similar Magic gear as alternatives.
Use Tome of fire or other spell-damage gear after the safespot is stable.
Carry a mind shield or other protective shield during the aggressive setup period.
Keep the shield in the inventory after swapping to Tome of fire or another magic off-hand.
Use the same 10-minute tolerance and obstacle trapping rules as Ranged safespotting.
risks: Magic off-hands do not protect from icy breath.
Safespot mistakes can force an immediate shield swap.

methods.label: Cannon and prayers
methods.summary: Use a dwarf multicannon only in the lower cave and choose protection prayer by distance.
recommendedFor: Players accepting cannonball cost for higher kill speed
prayers: Protect from Melee in melee distance
Protect from Missiles when ranging or maging without a complete safespot
steps: Set up the dwarf multicannon only in the lower part of the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.
Do not attempt to cannon the upper Slayer-exclusive area; the strategy page marks it as no cannon.
Use Protect from Melee when fighting directly.
Use Protect from Missiles when fighting from distance and not fully safespotted.
Keep the shield requirement unchanged even when cannoning.
risks: Cannonballs add cost, though the strategy page notes the extra drops often outweigh it.
Cannon use does not remove icy-breath or freeze risk.

methods.label: Inventory and loot
methods.summary: Carry the shield and support supplies while leaving room for noted resources, runes, herbs, and seeds.
recommendedFor: Players using herb sack or rune pouch
requiredOrKeyItems: Mind shield or stronger protective shield
Ranging potion, super combat potion, or imbued heart depending on style
inventory: Protective shield even when using an offensive shield after safespotting
Food for lure mistakes and freeze recovery
Rune pouch for alchemy or Magic combat
Bonecrusher for Wyvern bones if prayer experience or inventory management is desired
steps: Reserve one inventory slot for the protective shield if it is not currently equipped.
Use food and prayer potions until the safespot is stable or throughout melee trips.
Keep valuable drops such as rune arrows, rune items, battlestaves, unpowered orbs, magic logs, pure essence, ranarr seeds, snapdragon seeds, chaos runes, death runes, blood runes, and coins.
Bank or alch depending on trip length and rune pouch setup.
Remember the unique drops are granite legs and draconic visage, not wyvern visage.
notes: The strategy page examples show both combat-trip inventories and loot-focused inventories for Ranged and Magic safespotting.

styleOptions.label: Melee dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter lance or high-accuracy melee with Protect from Melee and an anti-icy-breath shield.

styleOptions.label: Ranged safespot
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter crossbow, Bow of faerdhinen, or crossbow alternatives after the 10-minute aggression timer.

styleOptions.label: Ranged Void safespot
styleOptions.summary: Void ranged version of the safespot method, recommended by the strategy page for 92+ Ranged without Armadyl-tier gear.

styleOptions.label: Magic Fire safespot
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter wand or Fire spell setup using the 25% Fire elemental weakness from a safespot.

body:
# Skeletal Wyvern

Draconic dragonbane target in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon. Carry an elemental, mind, dragonfire, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield for icy breath; use melee dragonbane directly or safespot with Ranged/Magic after aggression expires.
